pages.title: Plants of Gensokyo
pages.text: Many alchemy recipes depend on plants unique to Gensokyo: Ghost Fire, Dream and Demonic Miasma mushrooms from the Magical Forest, along with Star Flowers and Flame Cattails.

Keep a wide range of materials on hand. Many recipes combine several plants, and some also call for familiar things like powders and monster drops. The exact ingredients for every Alchemy Pot recipe are listed in JEI.
